title: Quantization profile impact evaluation and automatic threshold tuning for AWQ/GPTQ (int8/int4)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Build an evaluative pipeline and rollout gating system that quantifies quality regressions introduced by quantization profiles (AWQ/GPTQ) at int8 and int4 precision and automatically suggests/tunes thresholds used for canary and global rollouts. Deliverables: (1) a reproducible eval harness that runs model variants (float16, int8-AWQ, int8-GPTQ, int4-AWQ, int4-GPTQ) across a representative prompt corpus; (2) a metric suite (task-specific metrics + embedding similarity + human-style pass/fail signals) and a threshold tuning algorithm; (3) dashboard + alerts in Console and CI gates for Dedicated/Private deployments; (4) documented rollout policy examples and a small-scale field validation run against customer traffic via shadowing.
comments: 2025-02-15 - Maya Chen: Kickoff: scoped corpus (4k prompts) covering summarization, instruction following, code generation, factual QA, and multi-turn chat. Decided to include both synthetic stress prompts (long context, partial cache hits) and customer-derived samples from opt-in datasets.

2025-02-18 - Diego Alvarez: Initial harness prototype committed. Runs single-model comparisons and captures ROUGE-L, Exact Match, BERTScore, embedding cosine (avg), and perplexity deltas. GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/912

2025-02-21 - Product review (Ava Patel): Requested explicit per-task thresholds and a conservative early-warning band for canary (automatic rollback if >2% absolute ROUGE-L drop on summarization OR >0.02 drop in BERTScore on instruction tasks). Added label 'canary-gating'.

2025-02-25 - Diego Alvarez: Ran batch experiments across model variants on a 2k prompt subset. Summary (median deltas vs float16 baseline): int8-AWQ: ROUGE-L -0.9%, BERTScore -0.008, embed-cosine -0.003; int8-GPTQ: ROUGE-L -1.6%, BERTScore -0.012; int4-AWQ: ROUGE-L -3.8%, BERTScore -0.032; int4-GPTQ: ROUGE-L -5.1%, BERTScore -0.055. Latency and cost: int8 ~ -22% cost, int4 ~ -36% cost. Observed outlier failure modes on code-generation tests where EM dropped by >8% for int4-GPTQ.

2025-02-27 - Engineering discussion: Trade-offs recorded in design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Quant+Profile+Eval+Design. Decided to implement a two-tier threshold: (A) Early-warning band (soft alarm) for small regressions to trigger staged review, and (B) safety rollback band for immediate block/rollback in canary. Example thresholds: safety rollback if task-specific metric delta exceeds 3x baseline variance and absolute drop >2.5% ROUGE-L or >0.03 BERTScore; early-warning if delta >1x baseline variance and absolute drops exceed 0.8% ROUGE-L or 0.01 BERTScore.

2025-03-01 - QA: Added CI job 'quant-eval-check' to run against PRs that modify quant kernels or packaging. If safety rollback triggers, CI fails and creates an auto-ticket with artifacts. CI config: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/quant-eval-check

2025-03-02 - Diego Alvarez: Dashboard prototype in Console: per-model variant comparison, per-task violin plots for metric delta distribution, and per-threshold alerting. Live view: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant-eval (internal). Next: add automated threshold tuning job that ingests historical evals and recommends per-task thresholds based on 95th percentile of observed deltas during controlled experiments.
